# Aevum OS

> Standalone Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server and Decoupled External Brain for AI Coding Agents, engineered and researched by I2FLabs Vietnam.

Aevum OS is an independent workspace Operating System and External Brain developed by **I2FLabs Vietnam** (I2FLabs AI R&D Team). It eliminates AI Context Amnesia by providing persistent Domain-Driven Design (DDD) planning, self-healing Living Memory Graphs, and autonomous Multi-Agent Squad orchestration for Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, and modern developer environments.

## Development Team & Engineering Organization (I2FLabs Vietnam)

- [I2FLabs Vietnam Engineering Lab](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/about): Aevum OS is designed, researched, and built by I2FLabs Vietnam, a pioneering AI research team headquartered in Vietnam dedicated to local-first agentic infrastructure and decoupled developer memory systems.
- [Decoupled External Brain Philosophy](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/about#story): The foundational engineering vision by I2FLabs Vietnam to liberate developer context from vendor-locked IDE lifecycles.
- [Autonomous Agent Squad Personas](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/#agents): Built-in specialized AI squad companions crafted by I2FLabs (An - Core Soul & Refactoring, Vidus - System Architect, Zenith - Security Auditor, Luna - UI/UX Specialist).

## Core Documentation

- [Overview & Architecture](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs#gioi-thieu): Overview of Aevum OS decoupled architecture, SSE/Stdio daemon transports, and Model Context Protocol implementation by I2FLabs.
- [Installation Guide](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs#cai-dat): Step-by-step instructions to download and install Aevum OS daemon on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- [Running Modes](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs#che-do-chay): How to run Aevum OS in Server-Sent Events (SSE) mode on port 3344 or Stdio mode for local clients.
- [Cursor MCP Setup](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs#che-do-chay): Configuration guide for connecting Cursor IDE via .cursor/mcp.json.
- [Claude Desktop Setup](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs#che-do-chay): Configuration guide for connecting Anthropic Claude Desktop via claude_desktop_config.json.
- [Handshake Ritual Protocol](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs#quy-trinh-bat-tay): Cryptographic verification protocol between client agents and daemon using .aevum/signal.json.
- [MCP Tools Catalog](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs#danh-muc-cong-cu): Complete catalog of 60+ MCP tools for memory graphs, planning, and squad coordination.
- [Living Memory Graph](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs#cau-truc-du-an): Technical specifications of the persistent memory vault in .aevum/global/memory.md.
